segments.name: Packaging
segments.description: Packages bare semiconductors into finished semiconductors with enhanced electrical and thermal characteristics for chip and electronics customers.
segments.evidence: Packaging revenues increased by 17.8% to NT$308,342.6 million (US$9,829.2 million) in 2025 from NT$261,731.4 million in 2024.

segments.name: Testing
segments.description: Provides testing services, including front-end engineering testing, wafer probing and final testing, to semiconductor customers.
segments.evidence: Testing revenues increased by 31.8% to NT$71,900.2 million (US$2,292.0 million) in 2025 from NT$54,561.5 million in 2024.

segments.name: EMS
segments.description: Designs, assembles, manufactures and sells electronic components and telecommunications equipment motherboards for customers.
segments.evidence: Revenues from our EMS business decreased by 5.2% to NT$257,192.7 million (US$8,198.7 million) in 2025 from NT$271,293.3 million in 2024, primarily due to the slow recovery of general communication and automotive products.

segments.name: Others
products: sale and leasing of real estate properties
segments.description: Covers other activities such as substrate production and the sale and leasing of real estate properties.
segments.evidence: The Group engages in other activities such as substrate production as well as sale and leasing of real estate properties.

revenueModel.text: Customers, largely export customers, pay for semiconductor packaging, testing and electronics manufacturing services sold by the Group.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group packages bare semiconductors into finished semiconductors with enhanced electrical and thermal characteristics; provides testing services, including front-end engineering testing, wafer probing and final testing services; engages in the designing, assembling, manufacturing and sale of electronic components and telecommunications equipment motherboards.
